      protected abstract String getCommentFileName()
      Description copied from class: StoryGraphList
      Returns the name of the file in which the comments associated with the elements of this collection are stored when reading and writing a graph from file.

      By default, this method appends "_comments.txt" to the result of StoryGraphCollection.getSingular().
